plan.sampling: Each window starts a fresh daemon for each connection count. Save one validated status snapshot per before/held/after-disconnect phase, bracket it by PID/starttime checks, and derive CSV from that same snapshot. Pin every subject to CPU1 with identical argv[0].
plan.readiness: Exact HELLO and PING DATA/STATUS validation for every held connection; daemon FD count must grow by N and return to baseline. Invalid status, absent fields, changed identity or unexpected exit rejects the window.
plan.pss: This exact router lacks smaps/smaps_rollup: PSS remains NA, never zero. Process RSS does not measure kernel socket buffers, peaks or removable system RAM.
plan.purpose: R114 held-connection memory ablation against correct R113. Two reverse-order blocks, all five connection counts; no CPU or adoption claim.

limitations: Exploratory paired blocks only. RSS counters may be imprecise; no PSS or kernel-buffer/peak claim. Event loop clocks do not measure per-request tail latency. No pooling earlier runs.
